patterns: 完成式被動（has gradually been broken down）
虛主詞 It is wise to …

1.explanation_zh: 「過去，技職教育常被視為…」技職教育是被看待的一方，用過去式被動 was often regarded／seen as（「過去」→ 過去式）。「次等的選擇」an inferior／second-class choice（a second choice 是「備案」，意思不對）。「迫使許多有天分的學生…」是前面整件事造成的結果，中文沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞片語 , forcing many gifted students to …；force + 人 + to VR。「放棄自己的興趣」abandon／give up their own interests（興趣用複數）。
evidence: 迫使許多有天分的學生
1.strategy_zh: 句尾「…，迫使／使得…」表示前面整件事的結果 → , forcing／making + O + (to) VR；「被視為」→ be regarded／seen as。
hints: 切成四段：過去，技職教育常被視為／次等的選擇／迫使許多有天分的學生／放棄自己的興趣
標的詞彙：inferior／second-class（次等的）、choice（選擇）、force（迫使）、gifted／talented（有天分的）、abandon／give up（放棄）、interest（興趣）
句型框架：S + was often regarded as + N, forcing + O + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「然而，這種偏見已逐漸被打破」偏見是被打破的一方，「已…」用完成式被動 has gradually been broken down（gradually 可放在 has 和 been 之間）。前後是兩個完整的子句，要用 and 連接。「從高中就開始學習實用技能是明智的」主詞是一長串動作，英文用虛主詞 it is wise to …，把不定詞片語放到句尾；「從高中就」in high school／as early as high school。
2.strategy_zh: 「…是明智的／重要的」前面是一長串動作時 → It is + adj. + to VR；「已經被…」→ has/have been + p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：然而，這種偏見／已逐漸被打破／許多人認為／從高中就開始學習實用技能是明智的
標的詞彙：prejudice（偏見）、break（打破）、gradually（逐漸）、believe（認為）、wise（明智的）、practical（實用的）、skill（技能）
句型框架：S + has gradually been p.p., and many people believe + it is wise to VR …

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.2.patterns[0]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: In the past, vocational education was often regarded as an inferior choice, forcing many talented students to give up their own interests.
1.explanation_zh: 「過去…常被視為」用過去式被動 was often regarded as；「迫使許多學生放棄」承接前句結果，用分詞構句 forcing ... to give up；「次等的選擇」譯 an inferior choice（second-rate／second-class 亦可）。

2.translation: However, this prejudice has gradually been broken down, and many people consider it wise to start learning practical skills as early as high school.
2.explanation_zh: 「已逐漸被打破」是到現在為止的變化，用現在完成式被動 has gradually been broken down；「認為…是明智的」用虛受詞 consider it wise to V；「從高中就開始」強調早，譯 as early as high school（in high school 亦可）。「打破偏見」英文較常說 break down／overcome，故信心 medium。

issues_zh: 盲譯自然寫成 and many people consider it wise to start learning practical skills as early as high school（虛受詞 it＋形容詞＋to VR），文法正確且通順，但第 3 部分 accepted 只有 believe／think／feel，第 4 部分只收 it is wise to …，所以不在可接受寫法內。

target_words 的 believe 已把 consider、regard 列為 alternatives，parts 卻沒有任何能接 consider／regard 的寫法（consider it wise to …、regard it as wise to …；bonus 也用了 regard it as wise to），評分規準前後不一致；建議第 3 部分補 and many people consider／regard／find，第 4 部分補 it wise to …／it as wise to …。
標的句型 NFSUBJ 標成「虛主詞 It is wise to」，我用的是同一個 it＋adj.＋to VR 結構（gp-it-adj-to）的虛受詞版本，嚴格說沒有用到虛主詞，所以 used_patterns 沒列 NFSUBJ；「許多人認為…是明智的」同樣自然引出 consider it wise to …，建議把虛受詞寫法算作這個句型，否則中文題目沒有唯一引出虛主詞。

1.translation: In the past, vocational education was often regarded as a second-rate choice, forcing many talented students to give up their interests.
1.explanation_zh: 「過去」用過去式；「被視為」用 be regarded as 被動；「次等的選擇」譯為 second-rate choice；「迫使……」用現在分詞片語 forcing ... to 表結果。

2.translation: However, this prejudice has gradually been broken down, and many people consider it wise to start learning practical skills as early as high school.
2.explanation_zh: 「已逐漸被打破」用現在完成式被動 has gradually been broken down；「認為……是明智的」可用 consider it wise to V（it 作虛受詞），也可用 think that it is wise；「從高中就開始」譯成 as early as high school，語氣略有不同但可接受。

issues_zh: 我把「許多人認為……是明智的」譯成 many people consider it wise to start learning …（虛受詞 it＋形容詞＋不定詞），沒有用到標的句型 NFSUBJ 的句框 It is wise to …；中文「認為」後面沒有強制出現「it is」，學生可以用 consider it wise、regard … as wise、believe starting … to be wise 等寫法避開虛主詞句型。

第 3 部分 accepted 沒有 consider／regard 之類的動詞（標的詞 believe 的 alternatives 卻列了 consider、regard），而 consider it wise to 的結構會跨第 3、4 部分，兩邊的 accepted 都接不起來，所以我自然的譯文被判在可接受範圍外。建議第 3 部分補 'and many people consider'、第 4 部分補 'it wise to start learning practical skills …'，或在中文加線索（例如「認為……是明智的」改為「覺得這樣做很明智」）讓虛主詞更容易出現。
